mechanism: Foscarnet causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair sacubitril metabolism and increase neprilysin inhibitor accumulation, while also potentiating hypotension and renal dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; ensure adequate hydration during foscarnet therapy; consider temporary sacubitril dose reduction or discontinuation if eGFR declines significantly or severe electrolyte abnormalities develop.
